Despite explaining the entire incident, customer care refused to take any responsibility and declined to refund even the service fee. Their response was that they could not do anything from their end. This is completely unacceptable for a platform that claims to provide reliable and professional services. Customers pay for the convenience and trust that Urban Company promises, but when something goes wrong, there seems to be no accountability or customer protection. Urban Company needs to take responsibility for its technicians, investigate misleading quotations, and provide proper customer support. My advice to other customers: Always get a second opinion before approving expensive repairs through Urban Company. Extremely disappointing experience. I would think twice before using this platform again!
